title: Senior Manager- Human Resources Business Partner
description:
At PwC, our people in talent and development focus on finding, deploying, training and enabling talent through talent identification and enhancing employee skills and knowledge, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional growth. These individuals collaborate with subject matter specialists and project teams to strategize effective ways to locate, assess, educate and train employees, in line with market developments and firm strategy. As a talent generalist at PwC, you will focus on providing comprehensive talent support for leaders and guidance for employees, aligning talent strategies with business objectives. Your work will play a crucial role in improving employee retention, development and performance.
   

  

* Growing as a strategic advisor, you leverage your influence, expertise, and network to deliver quality results. You motivate and coach others, coming together to solve complex problems. As you increase in autonomy, you apply sound judgment, recognising when to take action and when to escalate. You are expected to solve through complexity, ask thoughtful questions, and clearly communicate how things fit together. Your ability to develop and sustain high performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our Firm.


**Skills**
 Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Craft and convey clear, impactful and engaging messages that tell a holistic story.
* Apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems and/or opportunities.
* Validate outcomes with clients, share alternative perspectives, and act on client feedback.
* Direct the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging and uncertain situations.
* Deepen and evolve your expertise with a focus on staying relevant.
* Initiate open and honest coaching conversations at all levels.
* Make difficult decisions and take action to resolve issues hindering team effectiveness.
* Model and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.


 The Opportunity
   

  

 When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. In our innovative hubs, you’ll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. You’ll also participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and professional skills.
   

  

 As part of the Talent and Development team you serve as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders with a focus on accelerating the development of people. As a Senior Manager you lead large projects, innovate processes, and maintain operational excellence while interacting with clients at a senior level to drive project success. You collaborate with partners/leaders to identify issues, develop and execute action plans across various areas of people strategy including diversity, development, performance management, and rewards and recognition.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead large projects and maintain operational excellence
* Innovate processes and drive project success
* Interact with clients at a senior level
* Serve as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders
* Accelerate the development of people
* Identify issues and develop action plans
* Focus on diversity, development, performance management, and rewards
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement


 What You Must Have
   

  

* High School Diploma
* 6 years of Human Capital or PwC Experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree preferred
* PHR or SPHR preferred
* Serving as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders
* Collaborating with partners/leaders on people strategy
* Leading talent management and succession planning
* Developing meaningful relationships with staff
* Focusing on diversity initiatives
* Applying coaching skills to increase effectiveness
* Managing resource requirements and project workflow

**Position Title:** Digital HR Analyst

**Position Type:** Regular \- Full\-Time


**Requisition ID:** 41957

 **Role Overview**


The Digital HR Analyst supports the design, configuration, testing, and optimization of HR technology systems whether through hands on implementation or strong business partnering with Technology resources. This role focuses on system functionality, access governance, elevated troubleshooting, and continuous enhancement.


This role is ideal for someone with strong hands\-on HR technology experience, playing a larger role in system configuration of HR processes, can communicate strongly to ensure HR needs translate into sound system logic and influence design, enjoys working cross functionally and has strong project management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**.

**Driving Technology Advancement**

* **Appropriately solve** HR problems with sustainable technical solutions in line with HR strategy, proactively managing impacts across systems, people and process.
* **Configure and maintain HR systems according to requirements,** updating settings, foundational data, workflows and security roles with precision.
* Serve as a **key escalation point for complex system issues**, partnering with IT and vendors to troubleshoot and resolve root causes.
* Own the **full UAT lifecycle** for their enhancements, including test script development, tester coordination, and validation that system updates support accurate and efficient business processes. Documents results, mitigates risks before deployment, identifies change impacts requiring communication or training, and surfaces process gaps to guide future enhancements.
* **Identify opportunities for automation in HR** processes and helps design and test workflow logic.
* Support system releases to ensure smooth deployment of mandatory and optional changes; identifying and mitigating impacts, sharing recommendations, and assisting with change management efforts,

 **Access Management**

* **Configure role\-based access structures** approved via governance or partners with necessary resources to do so, defining permission logic in line with the role.
* **Partner with IT** to align HR systems with **enterprise security standards**.

**User Enablement**

* **Keep clear and consistent technical documentation, job aids and user guides updated**, ensuring relevance and health of HR technology content.
* **Contributing content to, and answering questions from, Digital Training initiatives** to support HR staff in interacting with our technology.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

* **Provide expert input on system capabilities, constraints, and configuration options** related to prioritized strategic initiatives.
* **Facilitate working sessions** to gather requirements, validate designs, and resolve issues where required.
* **Represent HR in digital or process improvement initiatives** as a subject matter contributor.

 **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 3\-5 years of hands\-on HR Technology or business analyst experience.
* Certification in one or more of our key HR platforms (Time and attendance platform (UKG Workforce Pro is Preferred) and ServiceNow, Phenom, SuccessFactors).
* Strong understanding of HR processes (employee lifecycle, onboarding, timekeeping, talent management, performance, etc.)
* Proven ability to identify and manage change impacts of technology redesign.
* Strong ability to analyze issues, conduct root cause analysis and provide technically sound and sustainable solutions to problems, proactively mitigating impacts.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with cross functional teams.
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
* Enhancement coordination from facilitating requirement building for large process areas, design blueprinting, configuration, unit testing, user acceptance testing, change, deployment, operationalization.

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience working in an **agile** manner, i.e. **sprint\-based execution**.
* Experience using Agile tools to track work.

 **What Success Looks Like**

* **System changes deployed smoothly** with fewer defects and minimal post\-release issues because validation is thorough and aligned with business processes.
* **Recurring issues trend downward** because root causes are being addressed.
* **UAT cycles run efficiently**, with clear scripts, coordinated testers, and well documented results. **Defects are caught early**, reducing rework and preventing production disruptions.
* **Adoption improves** because systems are configured to meet broad business problems, have sustainable solutions the support HR processes, there are fewer process breakdowns and increased user experience.
* **SOPs, test scripts and configuration notes are current**, reducing knowledge gaps, streamlining project discovery and operations are more predictable/scalable.
* You are recognized as a trusted problem solver and **reliable partner** who understands both HR processes and technology.

title: HR Compliance Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Overview**


The India HR Compliance Senior Associate is responsible for ensuring adherence to Indian employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies across our India operations. This role focuses on managing employment\-related compliance processes, supporting policy governance as well as the employee life cycle, and mitigating risk through proactive monitoring and advisory. The position partners with HR Compliance leadership, Talent Business Advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure compliant and consistent HR practices in alignment with central and state labor laws.


This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast\-evolving compliance landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Employment Law Compliance, Reporting \& Policy Governance**

* Support compliance with key Indian labor law requirements, including but not limited to:


	+ Gratuity Act
	+ Shops \& Establishments Act (state\-specific)
	+ POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Act
	+ Leave\-related statutory provisions
	+ Severance and separation\-related compliance
* Update and communicate HR policies, procedures, and applicable Indian labor laws (central and state\-specific) to employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Support the review and maintenance of the India Employee Handbook to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Shops \& Establishments Acts, Industrial Employment regulations).
* Drive compliance program execution, including POSH awareness, training coordination, documentation, and audit readiness across office locations.
* Under the guidance of the India HR Compliance leader, provide support on policy interpretation in complex scenarios, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements and internal governance frameworks.
* Respond to employee and leadership queries related to HR policies, employment law, and compliance requirements.
* Identify compliance gaps and assist in drafting, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement of compliance processes, controls, and systems.
* Ensure audit readiness for internal and external compliance reviews, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting, including maintaining accurate documentation and timely submissions.
* Assist in preparing employment\-related documentation such as employment verification letters, compliance certifications, and policy communications.
* Support compliance awareness initiatives (e.g., HR Connect sessions) to promote understanding of policies and legal obligations.

**Time Off (Leave) Compliance – EL / CL / SL**

* Manage compliance aspects of employee time\-off programs, including Earned Leave (EL), Casual Leave (CL), and Sick Leave (SL), ensuring alignment with applicable state laws and company policy.
* Support leave tracking and compliance with statutory accruals, carry\-forward, and encashment rules.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on time\-off policies and ensure consistent application across the organization.
* Partner with HR systems teams to ensure accurate configuration and compliance of leave policies within HRIS platforms.

**Employee Relations \& HR Life Cycle Support**

* Escalate and support employee relations matters under the guidance of the HR Compliance Talent Relations leader, and in partnership with the Talent Business Advisor (TBA) team.
* Partner with the Talent Relations leader and Workplace Investigations team, as applicable, to ensure adherence to legal requirements and internal protocols regarding employee relations matters.
* Support governance of and ensure compliance with exit processes and employee separations, including adherence to applicable labor laws and statutory notice requirements, documentation standards, and internal processes.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 4\-7\+ years of relevant experience in HR compliance, employee relations, or HR operations within India.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory frameworks, including central and state\-specific regulations including Shops \& Establishments Acts.
* Experience supporting compliance programs such as POSH, gratuity, leave policies, and employee lifecycle compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply legal and policy requirements in practical business scenarios.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail with experience in audits, documentation, and compliance tracking.

**Core Competencies**

* **Judgement and Integrity:** Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision\-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving:** Ability to interpret complex regulations and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** Builds strong cross\-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.
* **Adaptability:** Operates effectively in dynamic, fast\-paced, evolving regulatory environments, and is comfortable with managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting change initiatives and shifting priorities.
* **Operational Excellence:** Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills with strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Proficiency in HRIS (e.g., Workday), compliance reporting tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

**Preferred/Additional Requirements**

* Professional certification in HR compliance, employment law, or related field (e.g., HRCI, SHRM, XLRI, CCEP, etc.).


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

title: Team Lead - Recruitment
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Team Lead – Recruitment \& Operations is a high\-energy, execution\-focused role at Honest Hire. The primary responsibility is to lead a team of recruiters, drive daily hiring activity, and ensure monthly closure targets are consistently met. This person will also support HR operations deliverables for client accounts. We are not looking for someone who just manages — we need someone who rolls up their sleeves, pushes the team, and owns outcomes. If you are energetic, target\-driven, and have a solid grip on recruitment with some exposure to HR operations, this role is built for you.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Recruitment Management**

▪ Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for client mandates across industries including manufacturing, construction, IT, retail, and services.

▪ Ensure a minimum of 30 position closures per month across all client accounts.

▪ Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed), employee referrals, headhunting, and talent databases.

▪ Conduct first\-level screening, competency\-based shortlisting, and coordinate interview scheduling with clients.

▪ Maintain and optimize JD quality, sourcing pipelines, and ATS data hygiene across all open positions.

▪ Track weekly sourcing metrics, submission ratios, interview\-to\-offer rates, and closure timelines per recruiter.

**B. HR Operations**

▪ Oversee HR operations deliverables for Honest Hire's client accounts including onboarding, documentation, offer letters, appointment letters, and HR policy rollouts.

▪ Coordinate payroll inputs (attendance, variable pay, new joiners, exits) with the payroll team and ensure timely monthly processing.

▪ Ensure all statutory compliance TATs are met — PF, ESIC, PT, TDS — with zero delays or errors.

▪ Manage employee lifecycle documentation: contracts, confirmation letters, increment letters, exit paperwork, and Full \& Final settlements.

▪ Handle client\-side HR escalations with ownership and timely resolution.

**C. Team Management**

▪ Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 3–5 recruiters and HR executives with weekly target setting and performance reviews.

▪ Conduct daily standups to track pipeline status, bottlenecks, and closures.

▪ Provide structured coaching and feedback; identify skill gaps and ensure continuous learning.

▪ Maintain team accountability through defined KPIs and weekly MIS reporting to the Founder.

**D. Client Management \& Business Support**

▪ Act as the primary SPOC for all recruitment and operations client accounts — own the relationship, communication, and SLA adherence.

▪ Share weekly and monthly MIS reports with clients covering hiring progress, ops compliance status, and escalation summaries.

▪ Identify upselling opportunities — e.g., converting a recruitment client to an HR operations client or vice versa.

▪ Support the Founder in onboarding new clients by setting up workflows, documentation frameworks, and team assignments quickly.

▪ Participate in client review meetings and business development discussions as required.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

▪ MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent (full\-time preferred).

▪ 3–7 years of experience in recruitment and HR operations, with at least 2 years in a team\-leading role.

▪ Proven track record of meeting bulk or high\-volume hiring targets (25\+ closures/month) in a consultancy or corporate setup.

▪ Hands\-on experience in HR operations: documentation, payroll inputs, and statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS).

▪ Experience working with small to mid\-size businesses or in an RPO/HR consultancy environment preferred.

▪ Languages: English \& Hindi (Marathi is an advantage).

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

▪ Prior experience in an HR consultancy, RPO, or staffing firm setup.

▪ Familiarity with ATS / HRMS platforms and structured recruitment reporting.

▪ Working knowledge of Labour Law, PF, ESIC, and PT compliance basics.

▪ Exposure to payroll coordination and full \& final settlement processes.

▪ Strong MS Excel and MIS reporting skills — ability to build and maintain dashboards.

▪ Network of candidates across industries: manufacturing, logistics, construction, retail, and IT.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

title: Junior Plant & Machinery Valuation Engineer
description:
***Only freshers / students in last year should apply for this position.***

**Junior Valuer:**

As a junior plant and machinery valuer, your job profile would involve learning and assisting senior valuers in various aspects of the valuation process. Here's an overview of what your role might entail:

* **Assistance in Inspections**: You would assist senior valuers in conducting inspections of machinery and equipment. This involves learning how to assess the condition, functionality, and overall quality of the assets.
* **Data Collection**: Gathering relevant information and data about the machinery and equipment being valued. This could include specifications, maintenance records, usage history, and other pertinent details.
* **Market Research Support**: Assisting in market research activities to gather information on industry trends, pricing data, and comparable sales to help determine the market value of the assets.
* **Documentation and Record\-keeping**: Learning how to maintain accurate records and documentation of valuation activities, including inspection reports, data sheets, photographs, and other relevant documents.
* **Data Analysis**: Supporting senior valuers in analysing collected data and information to help determine the appropriate valuation methodologies and approaches to be used.
* **Report Preparation**: Assisting in the preparation of valuation reports under the guidance of senior valuers. This may involve compiling data, drafting sections of the report, and ensuring that all necessary information is included.
* **Client Interaction**: Learning how to effectively communicate with clients to understand their valuation needs, gather additional information, and provide updates on the valuation process.
* **Continued Learning**: Actively engaging in ongoing training and professional development activities to expand your knowledge of valuation methodologies, industry standards, and relevant regulations.
* **Quality Assurance**: Participating in quality assurance processes to ensure that valuation reports meet the required standards of accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* **Team Collaboration**: Collaborating with other team members, including senior valuers, engineers, and administrative staff, to ensure smooth coordination and execution of valuation projects.

Overall, as a junior plant and machinery valuer, your role would involve learning the ropes of the valuation process, gaining hands\-on experience under the guidance of experienced professionals, and gradually taking on more responsibilities as you develop your skills and expertise in the field.

**About Janitri**

Janitri is a fast\-growing health\-tech company dedicated to improving maternal and newborn outcomes through innovative medical devices and digital health solutions. Our products are deployed across hospitals and healthcare systems, impacting thousands of pregnancies and births.

Over the years, Janitri has built a strong presence across **public and private healthcare ecosystems**, working closely with clinicians, hospitals, and government programs. With multiple recognitions and a growing footprint, we are now entering a **high\-growth phase focused on scale, adoption, and deeper impact**.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **VP – Customer Success** who can build and scale a **technology\-driven customer success function** that ensures strong adoption, retention, and impact across both enterprise healthcare customers and end users.

This role requires someone who understands that customer success is not just relationship management — it is about **building systems, leveraging technology, and driving outcomes at scale**.

You will work closely with product, clinical, sales, and operations teams to ensure our solutions are effectively adopted and deliver measurable value across both **B2B (hospitals, doctors)** and **B2C (end users / patients)** segments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the **end\-to\-end customer lifecycle** — onboarding, implementation, adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion.
* Build and scale a **tech\-enabled customer success function**, including CRM systems, automation, dashboards, and customer health tracking.
* Drive **product adoption and utilization** across hospitals, clinicians, and end users.

* Build and lead a high\-performing **Customer Success team**, including field teams, onboarding specialists, and account managers.
* Develop structured **customer feedback loops** and work closely with product and engineering teams to improve offerings.
* Monitor and optimize key metrics such as **NPS, retention, activation, engagement, and usage**.
* Identify risks proactively and ensure resolution to maintain strong customer relationships.
* Collaborate with sales and business teams to drive **upsell and cross\-sell opportunities**.
* Build deep relationships with hospital leadership, doctors, partners, and ecosystem stakeholders.
* Drive customer success strategies across both **public health programs and private healthcare institutions**.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* A leader who has **built or scaled customer success using technology and systems**, not just manual processes.
* Experience managing both **enterprise (B2B)** and **consumer (B2C)** customer success journeys.
* Strong understanding of **customer lifecycle, engagement, retention, and product adoption at scale**.
* Experience in **high\-growth environments**, building processes from scratch.
* Ability to balance **strategy with execution** in a fast\-paced setup.
* Strong stakeholder management across internal teams and external customers.

* Demonstrated exposure to both **enterprise customers and consumer\-facing products/services**.

**Why This Role Matters**

At Janitri, customer success directly translates to **clinical outcomes and lives impacted**. This role will define how our products are adopted, used, and scaled across healthcare systems and end users — making it one of the most critical leadership roles in the organization.

title: Content Creator & Brand Storyteller
description:
* Min. 1 to 3 years experience
* Surat (GJ), India

#### **About Us**

* Optimumbrew Technology LLP is a fast\-growing IT company specializing in innovative, user\-focused mobile and web application development. Backed by a strong **“Get Things Done”** culture, we bring together top engineering talent to deliver high\-quality digital solutions for clients across the **USA, Canada, UK, Australia**, and other global markets. We focus on creativity, technology, and long\-term partnerships to help businesses achieve meaningful digital growth.
#### **Job Description**

* We are looking for a **Creative Content Creator \& Brand Storyteller** who can transform ideas into compelling narratives and produce content that drives attention, emotion, and engagement.
* You will play a key role in shaping how our brand speaks, looks, and connects with audiences across digital platforms.
#### **Primary Objectives**

* Develop and execute compelling brand storytelling that builds strong emotional connections with the target audience.
* Create high\-quality, engaging, and platform\-specific content that drives **attention, engagement, and brand recall**.
* Establish and maintain a **consistent brand voice and narrative** across all digital channels.
* Leverage **consumer psychology, trends, and data insights** to craft impactful content strategies.
* Experiment with innovative content formats and storytelling techniques to improve reach and engagement.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align content with **marketing goals and business objectives**.
* Continuously optimize content performance using analytics, feedback, and creative iterations.
#### **Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Develop compelling stories, scripts, and content concepts for brand, product, and marketing campaigns.
* Produce high\-quality content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, website, blogs, and marketing videos.
* Craft emotionally engaging narratives using audience psychology and empathy\-driven communication.
* Conduct market, competitor, and trend research to identify fresh content opportunities and insights.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to ideate, structure, and refine creative content experiences.
* Create and experiment with trending content formats: reels, shorts, memes, storytelling videos, hooks, and visual narratives.
* Collaborate with designers, product managers, and marketing teams to execute cohesive content strategies.
* Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) for content research, ideation, concept building, and scriptwriting.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice, tone, and visual storytelling style across all digital touchpoints.
* Track performance metrics (views, engagement, watch\-time, shares) and recommend creative improvements.
* Assist in planning and executing creative campaigns that strengthen brand image and audience connection.
* Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, audience expectations, and communication objectives.
#### **Technical Skills You Should Have**

* Strong command of scriptwriting, storytelling, and narrative structuring for digital platforms.
* Proficiency in creating content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, websites, and blogs.
* Understanding of consumer psychology, emotional communication, and engagement\-driven content creation.
* Ability to use AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) for ideation, research, and content enhancement.
* Familiarity with short\-form video formats, hooks, pacing, and visual storytelling techniques.
* Basic knowledge of video editing tools (Premiere Pro, CapCut, VN, or similar) is an added advantage.
* Ability to conduct market research, competitor analysis, and trend identification.
* Strong grasp of social media algorithms, content patterns, and best\-performing formats.
* Experience in writing SEO\-friendly blog content (optional but beneficial).
* Ability to collaborate using tools like Notion, Google Workspace, Figma, or project management platforms.
#### **Key Expertise**

* Storytelling \& Scriptwriting: Ability to craft compelling narratives, hooks, and emotional scripts for digital platforms.
* Creative Concept Development: Skilled in generating unique ideas, content angles, and storytelling formats.
* Social Media Content Creation: Strong understanding of creating platform\-specific content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and blogs.
* Audience Psychology: Ability to decode user emotions, motivations, and behaviors to create relatable content.
* Trend Identification: Expertise in analyzing and leveraging social media trends, formats, and viral patterns.
* Visual Thinking: Strong sense of visual storytelling, scene setup, pacing, and message flow.
* AI\-Assisted Creativity: Proficient in using AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) for ideation, scriptwriting, and content enhancement.
* Market \& Competitor Research: Ability to identify industry gaps, opportunities, and creative direction ideas.
* Content Optimization: Skilled in improving engagement through hooks, structure, captions, CTAs, and formats.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Ability to work closely with design, product, and marketing teams for seamless execution.
#### **Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mass Communication, Marketing, Psychology, Design, Journalism, Media Studies, or related fields (preferred but not mandatory).
* 1–3 years of experience in content creation, digital storytelling, social media content, or creative strategy.
* Strong portfolio showcasing storytelling skills, content creativity, and digital platform understanding.
* Exceptional freshers with a strong Instagram presence, creative portfolio, or storytelling samples are encouraged to apply.
#### **Experience**

* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in content creation, storytelling, social media content, or digital marketing.
* Experience producing content for platforms like Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, websites, and blogs.
* Prior experience in creating scripts, short\-form videos, reels/shorts, or brand narratives is highly preferred.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams (design, product, marketing) to execute creative ideas.
* Exceptional freshers with a strong creative portfolio or high\-engagement Instagram presence may also apply.

Job description:

**Position: Software Sales \& Trainer**

**Company:** Fleetoz Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Industry:** Transport Technology / SaaS / Mobility Solutions  
**Location: Pune**

**About Fleetoz Solutions Pvt. Ltd.**

Fleetoz Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a technology\-driven company providing **SaaS\-based software solutions for corporate transportation and fleet management operations**. The Fleetoz platform helps organizations efficiently manage employee transportation, vendor management, trip scheduling, driver allocation, and billing processes through a centralized digital system.

The platform is designed to support **corporate mobility providers, car rental companies, and organizations managing employee transport operations**. Fleetoz enables companies to improve operational efficiency, transparency, and service quality through **real\-time tracking, automation, and data\-driven reporting**.

Fleetoz Solutions supports clients **across multiple cities in India and globally**, focusing on innovation, technology\-driven mobility solutions, and long\-term client partnerships.

**Role Overview**

The **Software Sales \& Trainer** will be responsible for promoting, selling, and supporting the **Fleetoz software platform** used for managing corporate transportation operations.

The role involves **generating software sales opportunities, conducting product demonstrations, closing yearly software licensing agreements with corporate clients and vendor partners, and providing system training to ensure proper software utilization**.

The candidate will act as the **primary point of contact for software\-related training, onboarding, and solution support for both corporate clients and car rental vendors**.

**Key Responsibilities:** 

**Software Sales \& Business Development**

* Promote and sell **Fleetoz software solutions** to corporate clients and car rental vendors.
* Conduct **cold calls, outreach, and follow\-ups** to generate software sales opportunities.
* Identify potential **corporate clients and vendor partners** who can benefit from the Fleetoz platform.
* Close **yearly software licensing agreements** with clients and vendors.
* Support the sales team in **software presentations and product demonstrations**.

**Software Demonstration \& Client Engagement**

* Conduct **software demonstrations and presentations** for prospective clients and vendor partners.
* Explain system features such as **trip management, vendor management, driver management, billing integration, and reporting tools**.
* Highlight the **operational and efficiency benefits** of using the Fleetoz platform.

**Software Training \& Implementation**

* Provide **software utilization training** to corporate clients and car rental vendors after onboarding.
* Conduct training sessions for **internal teams including operations, billing, supply, and account management**.
* Prepare **training materials, SOPs, and user guides** for system usage.
* Ensure clients and vendors understand the **complete workflow and features of the platform**.

**Client \& Vendor Support**

* Act as the **single point of contact for software\-related training, support, and solution guidance**.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Global Businesses & Functions
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will play a key role in driving end\-to\-end campus hiring for Global Business Functions (GBF) in India. You will partner closely with Hiring Managers, HRBPs, and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver a seamless, high\-quality hiring experience, ensuring strong pipeline creation, effective candidate assessment, and timely hiring outcomes. In this role, you will act as a trusted partner to the business, balancing hiring demand with market insights, while also focusing on enhancing candidate experience, strengthening campus engagement, and ensuring consistent execution of hiring processes at scale.  

Key responsibilities include:

 **End\-to\-End Recruitment**  

  

Manage full lifecycle recruitment for GAP roles across GS \& GSB  

Drive sourcing, screening, assessments, interviews, and offer processes  

Ensure timely closure of roles in line with hiring plans and SLAs

 **Campus Outreach \& Engagement**  

  

Drive campus outreach strategy across target universities and institutes  

Build and manage long\-term relationships with campus stakeholders (placement cells, faculty, student bodies)  

Lead and coordinate Pre\-Placement Talks (PPTs), info sessions, and engagement events  

Partner with Employer Branding teams to position BCG effectively on campuses  

Track campus performance and continuously refine outreach strategy

 **Stakeholder Management**

  

Partner with Hiring Managers to understand role requirements and hiring needs  

Provide regular updates on pipeline, progress, and hiring insights  

Guide stakeholders through interview and selection processes

 **Candidate Experience**  

Ensure a smooth and engaging candidate journey across all stages  

Manage communication with candidates throughout the hiring lifecycle  

Support post\-offer engagement and onboarding readiness in collaboration with HR

 **Program \& Process Management**  

Execute structured hiring processes (HireVue, ATS workflows, interviews)  

Monitor pipeline health and proactively address bottlenecks  

Drive continuous improvements in hiring processes and candidate engagement

 **Data \& Reporting**  

Track recruitment metrics (pipeline, conversion, timelines)  

Maintain accurate data in ATS and trackers  

Provide insights to improve hiring effectiveness and campus strategy

 **Diverse Hiring Exposure**  

In addition to campus hiring, you will have the opportunity to expand your scope into lateral hiring during off\-campus cycles, supporting broader talent needs across GBF functions  

Partner with stakeholders to identify and attract experienced talent, contributing to year\-round hiring continuity

  

What You'll Bring


Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred)  

2–4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Campus Hiring, or Early Talent  

Experience in campus outreach and university engagement preferred  

Experience managing high\-volume or program\-based hiring  

Familiarity with ATS platforms and assessment tools  

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills  

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver in a fast\-paced environment

  

Who You'll Work With

* You will work closely with:
* Hiring Managers across Gloal Services and Specialty Businesses
* HR Business Partners
* Talent Acquisition team members
* Recruitment Operations and Campus/Employer Branding teams
* External university stakeholders

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

description:
**Job Title: Manager – Workforce Management (WFM)** 




**Job Summary:** 




 The Workforce Management (WFM) Manager is responsible for driving operational efficiency and workforce optimization across contact center operations. This role focuses on forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and real\-time management to ensure service level achievement and effective resource utilization. The manager leads a team of scheduling , forecasting and Real\-Time Analysts (RTAs), collaborates with cross\-functional teams, and leverages data insights to enhance workforce planning accuracy and operational performance.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Workforce Planning \& Optimization** 



* Lead forecasting, capacity planning, and scheduling activities to ensure optimal staffing levels aligned with business requirements.
* Develop short\-term and long\-term workforce plans based on historical data, trends, and business projections.
* Ensure scheduling efficiency and maximize resource utilization while maintaining service level targets.
* Continuously refine forecasting models and planning assumptions to improve accuracy.



**Real\-Time Management \& Team Leadership** 



* Manage and mentor a team of Real\-Time Analysts (RTAs) to ensure effective intraday operations.
* Oversee real\-time queue performance and make staffing adjustments based on call volume fluctuations.
* Drive adherence to schedules and ensure prompt action during service level deviations or outages.
* Establish clear goals, performance metrics, and development plans for the RTA team.



**Performance Monitoring \& Reporting** 



* Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as service levels, shrinkage, occupancy, and adherence.
* Develop and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly performance dashboards using Excel or reporting tools.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to leadership based on workforce data analysis.



**Process Improvement \& Efficiency** 



* Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities within WFM processes.
* Conduct root cause analysis for variances in forecast accuracy or service delivery.
* Implement process improvements and best practices to enhance planning and execution.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across workforce management functions.



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Collaborate with operations, HR, and IT teams to align workforce strategies with business objectives.
* Communicate workforce plans, performance insights, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Act as a key point of contact for workforce\-related planning and operational decisions.



**Required Qualifications \& Skills:** 



* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 7\+ years of experience in Workforce Management within a contact center or service operations environment.
* **Core Expertise:** 
 Strong hands\-on experience in forecasting, scheduling, capacity planning, and real\-time management.
* **Tools \& Technology:** 
 Experience with WFM tools such as IEX, Avaya, Verint, or Blue Pumpkin; strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
* **Leadership Skills:** 
 Proven experience managing and developing RTA or WFM teams.
* **Analytical Skills:** 
 Ability to analyze large datasets, interpret trends, and make data\-driven decisions.
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration abilities.
* **Attention to Detail:** 
 High level of accuracy and focus on operational excellence.

description:
**HR Generalist** 





 RocketPay (Absird Financial Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) \| HSR Layout, Bengaluru (On\-site)
 




  





**About RocketPay** 





 We started in 2022 because the collections layer in India was broken. Lenders found out about defaults too late. Distributors waited months to know if a retailer would pay. Businesses had no compliant way to collect what was owed. Everyone was building at the transaction layer — nobody was going deeper into what happened after credit was given.
 




  






 We decided to build that infrastructure. Today, RocketPay sits between payment initiation and default — preventing losses before they happen, not cleaning them up after. We are not a payment gateway, and we are not a debt recovery platform. We are the pipe through which credit collections and recovery flows.
 




  





**The Role** 

  
 





 You'll own the full employee lifecycle — from hiring to exit — and help shape RocketPay's culture as we scale. This is a high\-ownership role ideal for someone early in their HR career who wants to learn fast and build things, not just run playbooks. We're an AI\-forward team, so you'll be expected to leverage modern tools to move quickly.
 




  





**What You'll Do** 



* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, interviews, offers
* Run onboarding for new hires and ensure smooth 30\-60\-90 day experiences
* Administer payroll and benefits via Razorpay Payroll; coordinate with finance on TDS/PF/ESIC compliance
* Maintain employee records, contracts, and HR documentation
* Handle employee queries, grievances, and day\-to\-day HR operations
* Support performance review cycles and engagement initiatives
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and statutory requirements
* Manage office operations — vendors, supplies, workspace coordination
* Drive culture\-building activities — team events, celebrations, offsites, rituals that make RocketPay a great place to work



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 0\-2 years of experience in HR (internships count)
* Fast learner with high agency — you figure things out, not wait to be told
* Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Notion AI, etc.) to work faster
* Familiarity with Indian labor/payroll compliance basics (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS)
* Hands\-on experience or willingness to learn Razorpay Payroll
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Based in Bengaluru, willing to work from office



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior experience at an early\-stage startup
* Exposure to HRIS/ATS tools
* Advanced Excel proficiency — compensation trackers, ESOP registers, compliance dashboards using VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and nested formulas
* Familiarity with POSH compliance — Internal Committee setup, complaints portal management, and annual filings
* Experience managing employee benefits — group health/term life insurance, endorsements, renewals, broker coordination
* Experience drafting employee documentation — offer letters, employment agreements, policy documents
* Strong process orientation and audit readiness mindset

 Email your resume with a short note about yourself to divyam@rocketpay.co.in with the subject line "HR Generalist\- \[Your Name]"

In 2024, PhonePe also launched Indus AppStore \- its own native Android\-based mobile app\-store built for Indian consumers providing app discovery and content in 12 Indian languages.
   

  

**Job Objective:** 
 Seeking a detail\-oriented HR Compliance Specialist for supporting the day\-to\-day operations related to various statutory compliances along with maintaining records, supporting inspections, and communicating with employees.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**

 Coordinate with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance with all statutory requirements pertaining to the labour laws .

 Maintaining and updating the mandatory ESIC records, including registers and Form\-6, for ensuring 100% audit readiness for statutory inspections.
   

  

 Supporting employees with benefits and claims (sickness, maternity, accident reports) by coordinating with local ESIC offices (through the Compliance Partner) to ensure compliance.
   

  

* Documentation and Record\-Keeping:


 Maintain meticulous records of all compliance\-related activities \- registers, notices, responses, filings, and communications pertaining to the various statutes as required.
   

  

 Ensure that employee records and documentation are maintained as per statutory and audit requirements.
   

  

**Capabilities \& Requirements:**

title: Assistant Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Talent Consultant\- Manager**
 If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career experience as a Talent Consultant in a high\-growth organization, we have a role here. At EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming and belonging. We care for our business, society and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 You will be responsible for supporting the Talent agenda for a business unit in EY GDS and will be the key point of contact for leadership on a range of talent related matters. You will drive and implement the engagement agenda, work closely with other members of the team to providing change leadership, increase workforce capability and talent management. You will build a deep understanding of business unit direction and Talent related topics/issues to ensure successful implementation of key projects and processes.
   

  

 You will need to be collaborative, influential and work across functions to execute on attracting, assimilating, developing, engaging and retaining key talent. You will drive project management for various HR initiatives, including Workforce Planning, Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward \& Recognition etc.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Support the Strategic Talent Consultant in designing a sustainable and scalable engagement framework for the business unit and take ownership for the delivery
* Provide support to the business leaders and counsellors in the implementation of engagement initiatives across the business unit
* Responsible for building, developing and managing other members of the talent consulting team, ensuring continued focus on the talent agenda
* Anticipate issues and needs within the business unit and address these effectively
* Act as a coach to business leader/managers in relation to delivering the people strategy agenda
* Provide insight on people issues, particularly ER cases within business unit, provide a robust point of view on business decisions and their impact upon people
* Ensure that all necessary people management and development activity required to support the business unit is delivered in the most professional and effective manner
* Execute innovative HR programs
* Facilitate change and support the implementation and successful adoption of special projects and initiatives in the business unit, for example: Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward exercises
* Ensure compliance to local regulations and manage risks (e.g. performance management risk)


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, ability to develop clear, actionable plans in support of an overall business unit strategy
* Strong client focus with the ability to build good relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
* Strong Employee Relations experience of complex disciplinary, grievance and performance management activities, especially with employees in senior management/leadership level
* Motivate team members through effective monitoring, coaching, counselling and providing a positive working environment
* Develop strong relationship with other Talent Centre of Excellence teams to ensure that centrally developed products and initiatives meet the requirements of the business unit
* Ability to work with ambiguity and build consensus across diverse, often global, groups


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate or a post graduate qualification in a Business or Human Resource discipline is desirable.
* 8 \-12 years of proven HR generalist experience (e.g. performance management, employee relations)
* Experience in managing and mentoring teams


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A professional accreditation or HR specialization certification
* Experience working in a consulting organization or in a similar professional services environment
* Experience of working in a cross\-border, virtual environment would be beneficial


**What We Look For**
* Be an enabler of high\-performance Talent team.
* Keen interest to invest time for self\-learning, seeking opportunities to work on cross\-functional HR projects
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* A self\-starter, independent\-thinker, curious and creative person with desire and passion


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

description:
**Primary Purpose:** 




 The Workday Analyst – Workday provides expert functional and technical support for the global Human Resource Information System (HRIS) function. Under the direction of the Director of Global HR Technology, you’ll translate business requirements into scalable Workday configurations, streamline processes, improve data quality, and deliver insights that help leaders hire, onboard, develop, and retain talent. You will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Learning \& Development, and HR to drive enhancements from discovery through testing and deployment, ensure strong governance, and prepare the organization for Workday releases.

* Build and maintain EIBs for mass updates
* Supports reporting needs for company’s Affirmative Action Plans.
* Review current HR system functionality for possible improvements, troubleshooting issues, testing new features, and developing and delivering end\-user training materials.
* Plan and execute unit, integration, and acceptance testing; and create specifications for systems to meet approved business requirements.

 Bachelor’s Degree

* Strong project management and process management skills
* Advanced knowledge and understanding of HR processes, procedures, and policies to translate business requirements into the system.
* Experience diagnosing, isolating, and resolving issues and recommending and implementing strategies to resolve problems.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to work with cross\-functional teams and facilitate teams to identify and implement solutions to complex problems.
* Position requires compliance with legal requirements and strict confidentiality of records and information.
* Demonstrated strong attention to detail, accuracy, problem\-solving, critical thinking
* Strong time and project management skills
* Strong interpersonal skills in dealing with all levels of employees and management
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.



  





**Preferred Job Requirements:** 



* Minimum of 3 years' experience supporting Workday configuration in areas such as HCM, Recruiting, Talent Management, Learning and Onboarding.

* Experience administrating HRIS, Applicant Tracking System, and similar employee management software
* Background in supporting HR functional processes (Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, core HR, etc.)
* Previous exposure to project\-related activities through active participation in system\-related projects
* Experience configuring reports and analytics

description:

 Onsite
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Network Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for the implementation, maintenance, and optimization of our complex data center network infrastructure. You will leverage your deep expertise in Cisco routing and switching, VMware NSX, and other cutting\-edge technologies to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of our network. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of successfully managing large\-scale network projects, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and delivering exceptional results in a fast\-paced environment.

* Configure and troubleshoot Cisco NX\-OS, IOS\-XE, and ACI platforms
* Implement and manage VMware NSX and DFW solutions
* Manage and maintain Fortinet, Juniper, and Cisco firewalls
* Plan, coordinate, and execute network infrastructure migration projects

* Ensure compliance with bank standards, processes, and controls
* Perform documentation, knowledge transfer, and handover to the operations team
* Monitor network performance and proactively identify and resolve issues
* Develop and maintain network diagrams and documentation
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest networking technologies and trends

* Strong expertise in Routing \& Switching, Catalyst, and Nexus with at least 5 years of experience at an expert level

* Hands\-on working experience with Cisco NX\-OS \& IOS\-XE, and Cisco ACI

title: Network Engineer - Senior Associate
description:
At PwC, our people in software and product innovation focus on developing cutting\-edge software solutions and driving product innovation to meet the evolving needs of clients. These individuals combine technical experience with creative thinking to deliver innovative software products and solutions. Those in software engineering at PwC will focus on developing innovative software solutions to drive digital transformation and enhance business performance. In this field, you will use your knowledge to design, code, and test cutting\-edge applications that revolutionise industries and deliver exceptional user experiences.
   

  

**Management Level**
 Senior Associate
   

  

****Job Description \& Summary****
 At PwC, our people in Cloud Engineering, Data and Analytics (CEDA) team focus on providing solutions to meet the evolving needs of clients. These professionals leverage their technical expertise, creative insights, and business acumen to provide innovative solutions in hybrid\-cloud environments
   

  

 At PwC, our people in infrastructure focus on designing and implementing robust, secure IT systems that support business operations. They enable the smooth functioning of networks, servers, and data centers to optimize performance and minimize downtime.
   

  

 As a network engineer at PwC, you will focus on leading the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise network infrastructure transformations to deliver seamless connectivity and high availability for clients. You will be work on collaborative teams and implementing industry\-leading practices for complex, multi\-environment networking engagements.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As part of the CEDA practice, you will support cross\-functional engagements with a focus on networking, combining deep technical expertise with strong client advisory skills to deliver transformational outcomes. As a Manager you will supervise and mentor teams, manage client accounts, and facilitate the successful delivery of complex network programs. This role offers a unique opportunity to enhance your leadership capabilities while working with advanced networking technologies across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
* Lead the design and delivery of enterprise network solutions spanning routing and switching, data center, security, and hybrid cloud connectivity domains.
* Develop and present network architecture recommendations, business cases, and risk assessments to stakeholders at all levels
* Promote a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement
* Maintain adherence to project timelines and quality standards
* Analyze and refine operational processes for effectiveness


****Preferred Knowledge Areas:****
* Network Design \& Architecture
* Design of scalable, resilient enterprise network architectures including LAN, WAN, data center, and edge environments.
* Expert\-level knowledge of routing protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) and switching technologies (e.g., VLANs, STP, RSTP, VxLAN, EVPN).

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you'll step into an entry\-level role where your primary focus will be providing managed services to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. **Title: Network Engineer \- Senior** 




**Work Location: India** 




**Duration: 12 Months** 




**Job Type: Temporary Assignment** 




**Work Type: Remote** 




  





**Overview:** 








 TekWissen is a global workforce management provider headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan that offers strategic talent solutions to our clients worldwide.
 







**Job Description:** 



* We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Network Engineer who will be responsible for the architectural design, implementation, and highest level of support for our global enterprise network.
* This is a fantastic opportunity to bring your deep experience and creativity to a leadership role within our team.
* The successful candidate will be a dedicated team player, able to drive the business forward while mentoring others in a remote, 24x7 operational environment.



**Your Impact:** 



* Provide end\-to\-end ownership and serve as the subject matter expert for our global network infrastructure.
* Lead the architectural design, setup, and configuration of network systems for new office sites from the ground up.
* Provide comprehensive support for our global network infrastructure, including monitoring, alert management, and maintenance (patching, upgrades, and tuning).
* Drive strategy for network maintenance, including major upgrades, patching, and performance tuning to ensure maximum stability and performance optimization.
* Provide expert\-level support for our core network technologies from both proactive and reactive positions. For: Cisco Meraki Switches, Wireless Access Points, Meraki and Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco routers, Global Protect VPN, and Portnox.
* Monitoring services and alerts for: network gear, and SaaS services, and perform initial triage for network/SaaS platform issues.
* Act as the final escalation point for critical network issues, providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members.
* Managing ticket queues, tickets and escalations
* Act as an escalation point for complex troubleshooting, collaborating with the team and office stakeholders to ensure timely remediation.
* Develop and maintain documentation for implementation guidelines, runbooks, reusable design templates, and support templates.
* Work with a drive for success to ensure the stability and reliability of our network.
* Flexibility to work rotating shifts and when required to respond to escalations outside of your scheduled shifts
* Ability to act as a team lead, managing items such as but not limited to maintaining the teams shift rotation schedule, on call rotations, and internal team escalations



**Your Experience:** 



* 7\+ years of extensive experience managing and designing corporate IT network systems in a modern, global environment.
* Deep expertise in network infrastructure and monitoring principles.
* A dedicated and hardworking individual with a strong drive for success and proven experience in continuous improvement to drive the business forward.
* Significant experience leading the deployment of network infrastructure for new sites
* Maintaining ticket queues, tickets and escalations
* Working with IT operations management (ITOM) software that monitors and alerts on an organization's IT infrastructure, from network devices to servers and applications
* Deep expertise and strong hands\-on experience with Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto, Global Protect VPN, and Portnox.
* An excellent team player with superior communication skills, able to collaborate effectively with teams and stakeholders in a globally disbursed environment.
* A track record of providing guidance and mentorship to develop junior team members.
* Flexibility to provide leadership and coverage in a 24x7 shift operation. Which may include an on\-call rotation.
* Must have reliable internet for this remote position.
* BA or BS Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent experience.



**Nice to Haves:** 



* Advanced Technical Certifications (e.g., CCNP, CISSP, etc.).
* Can provide examples of projects or initiatives you’ve helped deliver to business stakeholders.
* Experience in leveraging AI technologies to assist in your role.
* You prefer to solve problems with code over clicks.
* Strong orientation to be results and data\-driven.



**TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.**

title: Software Engineer -Backend
description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

 We want to hire ambitious, and value\-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. Modulr is experiencing significant growth, and in this role you will work in a cross\-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high\-growth environment with a fast\-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems.
   

  

**About Us**
 At Modulr, our vision is a world where all businesses are powered by embedded payments. Modulr enables businesses, from SMEs to Enterprise, initially across the UK and Europe to efficiently pay\-in, collect and disburse funds instantly via a range of payment schemes, accounts, and card products.
   

  

 We have created an industry\-leading API platform with comprehensive online tools and access, to meet the demands of daily business payments. We have two routes to market. Our Core Business Payments product allows customers in any sector to connect to us and our expanding network of accounting and payroll platforms, including Sage, Xero, BrightPay and IRIS to automate payments. Our Vertical Solutions targets a growing range of industry verticals which directly connect their IT platforms to our APIs and webhooks. We solve complex payment problems for hundreds of clients in a range of industries, including Travel, Lending, Wage Advance, and Investment \& Wealth.
   

  

 We are deeply integrated into the payment eco\-system. In the UK, we are direct participants of Faster Payments and Bacs. Modulr hold settlement accounts at the Bank of England. Our payment network connectivity includes CHAPS, Open Banking, SEPA, SWIFT and account issuance in multiple currencies. We are principal issuing members of Visa and Mastercard schemes across UK and Europe.
   

  

 Our regulatory permissions and governance structure are the foundations of our business. We are regulated and supervised as an Authorised Electronic Money Institution (AEMI) in the UK by the Financial Conduct Authority and in the Netherlands by De Nederlandsche Bank.
   

  

 Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by the venture arms of payments giants PayPal and FIS, as well as growth investors Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog Capital and Highland Europe.
   

  

 Modulr now has over 400 employees spread globally across offices in London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**Modulr values**
* Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile.
* Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.
* Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey.
* Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite.


**The Team**
 At Modulr we are focused on building autonomous squads that are focused on working in
   

  

 the best possible way. We operate in a tribes and squad model with each area focused on
   

  

 a particular growth area. Each squad is small and cross\-functional. We have big ambitions and have many interesting challenges ahead.
   

  

**Summary**
 In this role you will design, build, and evolve the next generation of Modulr’s event\-driven payments platform. You’ll work across the full engineering lifecycle—from shaping technical approaches to delivering production\-grade software—within a squad that values ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Specific duties
   

  

**Engineering \& Architecture**
* Design and develop backend services using Java (17\+) or similar OO languages.
* Build and evolve microservices and distributed, event\-driven components in a cloud\-native environment.
* Contribute to architectural patterns that support throughput, resilience, reliability, and observability.
* Design clean, well\-documented RESTful APIs and service contracts.
* Work with relational data stores, especially PostgreSQL, and contribute to data modelling.


 Distributed Systems \& Reliability
   

  

* Engineer solutions for concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, retries, and high availability.
* Improve system performance, reduce latency, and identify bottlenecks across services.
* Build systems with strong observability—logs, metrics, tracing—ensuring issues can be diagnosed quickly.


**Quality \& Testing**
* Develop comprehensive automated tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber.
* Participate in design and code reviews, helping raise engineering standards across the team.
* Advocate for code quality, maintainability, and long\-term technical health.


 DevOps, Cloud \& Tooling
   

  

* Use and improve deployment pipelines and operational tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS services).
* Contribute to internal frameworks, shared libraries, and engineering best practices.
* Help shape the evolution of our platform toward a more flexible, modern architecture.


 Collaboration \& Delivery
   

  

* Work in an agile environment, contributing to planning, design discussions, and iterative delivery.
* Collaborate across squads to shape technical solutions that span multiple systems.
* Document best practices, reference architectures, and design approaches others can rely on.


**About You**
 You’re an engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and enjoys solving complex, system\-level problems. You bring:
   

  

* Expertise in Java or another OO language with willingness to work in Java.
* Strong understanding of OOP, design patterns, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience building and operating microservices in production.
* Ability to reason about concurrency, performance, and system behaviour under load.
* Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative, team\-first mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills supported by sound engineering judgement.
* Ability to manage complexity, balance competing priorities, and deliver high\-quality work.
* A growth mindset—you enjoy learning, improving, and helping others grow.
* A self\-starter attitude with a passion for ownership and continuous improvement.


**ModInclusion**
 At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it’s also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

 The Core Services organization is responsible for the foundational technology that powers Workday’s applications and platform products. We design, build, and support a highly\-performant distributed system that handles complex workloads at the scale required by the world’s largest organizations. Our infrastructure runs across both Workday data centers and public cloud environments, executing mission\-critical business processes, functions, and integrations. The organization's scope spans from the Gateway to the persistence layer, delivering the scalability, reliability, and efficiency needed to support Workday’s rapidly evolving product landscape.

Whether you thrive with solving sophisticated business problems, collaborating with agile teams, or championing innovation and software design, Workday offers an environment where your talents can thrive.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our Software Engineers deliver core features and services while collaborating with multiple partners and mentoring team members. We use mainly Java and Scala, and are pursuing Senior Software Engineers who have deep experience in multi\-threading, concurrency, and solving exciting distributed systems design problems! You will be involved in all aspects of software development, including designing, coding, testing, deploying, while providing support for our customer\-facing software solutions.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop and deliver enterprise grade solutions with robust unit tests and metrics
* Maintain continuous improvement within the team to ensure a high quality service

 Xperi (NYSE: XPER) is a publicly traded technology company headquartered in San Jose, CA with over 2,000 employees across North America, Europe and Asia. Come join a thriving team where you can play an integral role in shaping the future of entertainment technology.
   

  

**About the role:**
 Join a team that is dedicated to support and create the world class Network environment which is highly available and resilient. As Senior Network Engineer you’ll play a role to support company wide network environments as part of Global IT team. Enjoy the opportunity to draw on your passion for problem\-solving and simplifying tasks, as well as your technical skill set to make important contributions to the environment. You will be working very closely with other global team members to support the enterprise network and come up with world class network for our employees.
   

  

 This role will play a key part in improving network reliability, building modern monitoring platforms, and ensuring high availability of critical infrastructure across data centers, cloud environments, and office locations. Provides guidance and expertise to management and users on topics surrounding strategy and best practices. Solves complex problems and takes a new perspective on existing solutions.
