description:
**About The Role**
 As a Full\-Stack Software Engineer within Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS), you will architect the travel commerce engines powering our rapid expansion into APAC markets. This role is critical to building and localized world\-class travel portals for major financial institutions and consumer brands (such as CommBank and Trip.com), directly impacting how millions of users in the region experience travel.
   

  

 You will join a high\-velocity team responsible for adapting Hopper’s market\-leading fintech and e\-commerce stacks to meet the specific regulatory and consumer demands of the world's fastest\-growing travel market.
   

  

**What Would Your Day\-to\-day Look Like**
* Design and operate full\-stack solutions and APIs optimized for high\-scale B2B commerce partnerships across APAC.
* Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to localize portal features, ensuring seamless integration with regional payment and distribution standards.
* Leverage LLMs and AI tooling to generate production\-grade code that accelerates the delivery of partner\-specific requirements.
* Develop and maintain gRPC and REST\-based microservices that power real\-time travel inventory and fintech ancillaries.
* Work autonomously to resolve complex technical challenges while maintaining strong asynchronous alignment with global stakeholders.
* Iterate quickly on engineering improvements that enhance the scalability and performance of our B2B travel ecosystems.


**An ideal candidate has**
* Extensive experience with React and TypeScript used to build highly localized, performant web interfaces for complex e\-commerce environments.
* Proficiency in Scala and distributed systems or a strong desire to apply functional programming to large\-scale backend architectures.
* Commercial mindset that prioritizes regional product\-market fit and the unique user behaviors found in APAC digital ecosystems.
* Adeptness with AI\-driven workflows, including the use of LLMs for development and the implementation of agentic AI systems to enhance partner support.
* Hands\-on knowledge of GCP and cloud\-native practices, specifically in managing the latency and data residency requirements of international partnerships.
* Strong technical agility and the ability to fearlessly navigate unknown codebases to deliver high\-impact features under tight commercial deadlines.


**Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us**
* Well\-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre\-IPO equity packages.
* Carrot Cash travel stipend.
* Hopper offers a monthly cash allowance to cover the cost of private Medical, Dental and Vision \& Life insurance expenses as part of your CPC (Cost\-To\-Company)
* Voluntary employer contribution as part of your Employee Provident Fund (EPF)
* Very generous parental leave
* Flexdesk All Access Pass \& Work\-from\-home stipend.
* Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
* Open communication with management and company leadership.
* Small, dynamic teams \= massive impact.


**More about Hopper**
 At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world\-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.
   

  

 The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.
   

  

 While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.
   

  

 Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end\-to\-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.
   

  

**Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:**
 Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
   

  

 Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no\-questions\-asked resolutions.
   

  

 Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1\.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
   

  

 Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.
   

  

 Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co\-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.
   

  

 Hopper has been named the \#1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the \#3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen\-Z and millennials travelers.
   

  

 Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

description:
**Job Title: Associate Talent Acquisition** 

Location: Delhi HQ – Full\-time on\-site

Reporting To: Head of Talent Acquisition

Employment Type: Full\-time

Start Date: As early as possible.

**About the Company \& Project**

Carbon Secure India Pvt. Ltd. (CSI) is a fast\-growing climate\-tech startup building a large\-scale biochar carbon removal project on a 60 acre site.

Using paddy straw and rice husk as feedstock, we operate artisanal kilns scaled to industrial levels in Ludhiana, Punjab.

Carbon is sequestered through innovative burial of biochar in underground vertical silos for durable, high\-integrity credits.

Commercial production commences in June 2026, with a targeted scale\-up to 50 MT of biochar per day by year\-end.

We are now enhancing our infrastructure with an innovative molten salt pyrolysis process that will scale considerably at exceptional pace.

**Role Overview**

As Associate Talent Acquisition, you will support the Head of Talent Acquisition in executing high\-volume, high\-quality recruitment across senior, technical, and operational roles.

This is a hands\-on role ideal for someone who enjoys end\-to\-end recruitment, thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment, and wants to grow with a high\-impact climate\-tech company.

You will gain exposure to hiring for climate\-tech leadership, engineering, procurement, supply chain, and operations roles while building strong recruitment skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

Support full\-cycle recruitment for multiple open positions simultaneously (leadership, technical, and site\-based roles in Ludhiana).

Post jobs on Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other relevant platforms; manage responses and applications.

Conduct initial resume screening, candidate shortlisting, and preliminary phone/video screening calls.

Coordinate interview schedules with candidates, hiring managers (including the Founder), and the Ludhiana team.

Maintain accurate and updated candidate pipelines and tracking sheets.

Assist in preparing offer letters, conducting reference checks, and supporting onboarding documentation.

Help with candidate experience — timely communication, feedback, and follow\-ups.

Support sourcing through direct outreach, employee referrals, campus networks, and niche job portals.

Track recruitment metrics (time\-to\-hire, source effectiveness, etc.) and prepare simple weekly reports.

Coordinate logistics for Ludhiana site interviews and candidate visits.

Contribute to building a strong employer brand for our climate\-tech mission.

**Requirements**

1–4 years of experience in recruitment / talent acquisition (experience in startups, manufacturing, engineering, or agribusiness is a plus).

Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (HR, Business, or related fields preferred).

Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi.

Strong organisational and coordination skills with high attention to detail.

Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Workspace, and comfort with job portals / LinkedIn Recruiter.

Proactive, energetic, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic startup environment.

Genuine interest in climate action and sustainability is highly desirable.

Willingness to occasionally travel to Ludhiana for candidate coordination.

**Compensation**

Base Salary: ₹6 – 8 lakhs per annum (depending on experience)

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should send their resume and a short note (max 150 words) explaining why they are interested in joining a climate\-tech startup and building recruitment capability.

Please mention “Associate Talent Acquisition” in the subject line and include your expected salary and earliest joining date.

Applications should be sent to founder@carbonsecure.in .

 is an IT consulting and software outsourcing company that offers a full range of high\-quality, cost\-effective Software Development and IT solutions to businesses worldwide. With a focus on customer service and support,

 Develop Boolean search strings and conduct passive talent outreach campaigns.

 Conduct initial telephonic or video interviews to assess technical and soft skills.
 



 Validate resumes for relevance, accuracy, and match to job requirements.
 



 Coordinate technical assessments when required.

 Schedule and manage candidate interviews with hiring managers and technical panels.
